text:
Alex Rivera: Anyone seen AltForward's update? They just pushed the H200 batch into a customs hold. AWB mismatch reported, ETA window blurred. Need an RMA cutoff and diversion plan ASAP.
Marco (AltForward): Sorry for the curveball — customs flagged HS code on a subset. AWB: `AWB-ALF-9987`. ETA window 2026-03-28 -> 2026-04-02. We can split shipment but need explicit routing instruction by 12:00 UTC tomorrow. Can ship ~60% now, hold 40%.
Jess K: 60% helps but firmware parity is a hard requirement for our EU pool. Which SKUs/serials are included in the partial?
Marco (AltForward): Partial shipment = SKU `H200-32C-v2` serials S1000-S1580 (approx 580 units total, ~348 now). Firmware: mostly `f2.1.0`, ~20 units on `f2.0.8`. We can flash to `f2.1.0` pre-ship but that adds ~48h. Alternative: ship as-is + do a post-delivery RMA/flash.
Maya Chen: We can't intake mixed-firmware into EU due to regulatory/benchmark cert hangups. Can we divert the partial to US where we have buffers? @Sean Patel to confirm capacity.
Sean Patel: US pool shows ~120 slots free across IAD and ORD, but moving will push maintenance windows. If we divert 60% to US we can cover latency-sensitive services for ~2 weeks. We need infra tag changes: `fleet:divert-us=1` and an updated routing policy in the fleet router.
Liam O'Connor: Cost side: diversion + air uplift + broker fees ~= +$9.2k. Post-delivery reflash/RMA has ops cost (estimated 6 engineer-hours). Which is cheaper long-term?
Jess K: I prefer covering reflash over paying air uplift. Ops disruption from cross-region moves is higher than a scheduled reflash batch.
OpsBot: RMA ticket created -> RMA-4823 for AWB-ALF-9987. Link: https://ops.redwood/rma/4823 :white_check_mark:
Alex Rivera: Options: 1) Accept partial split to US (we cover uplift) 2) Wait for full EU clearance (delay) 3) Accept partial into EU but tag/quarantine units and gate them. Thoughts?
Sean Patel: Option 3 requires staging racks + hardware tagging + network ACLs. FRA-3 has ~24 immediate spots for quarantine racks — not enough for whole partial. Quarantine also requires NVLINK gating.
Maya Chen: If quarantined, we must disable NVLINK and block cluster pooling for those hosts to avoid cross-firmware anomalies. That adds orchestration work.
Marco (AltForward): We can hold EU portion on our side if you prefer. If you quarantine on arrival, we'll mark units as `QA-HOLD` and include RMA paperwork.
Liam O'Connor: We should ask vendor for a credit for the customs delay — propose 10%? If they won't, we absorb uplift.
Jess K: I'll push procurement to negotiate. @Marco can AltForward accept an invoice adjustment (partial credit) for customs-caused delay?
Marco (AltForward): Escalating now. Preliminary yes to 5-8% credit OR expedited shipping waived on the held remainder. Will confirm by EOD.
Alex Rivera: Proposed plan: ship 60% -> US buffer, hold 40% EU on vendor side or quarantine on arrival (QA-HOLD). Procurement to request 8% credit. Ops to create staging playbook + disable NVLINK for tagged units. Instruction deadline to vendor 12:00 UTC tomorrow. Any blockers?
Sean Patel: Need serial list and DOA/thermal exceptions flagged before we commit. Also confirm crossdock availability at IAD-2 for arrival.
Marco (AltForward): CSV with serials + manifest being prepared. Manifest: `MFST-4792`. I'll send CSV by EOD today.
Liam O'Connor: I'll pre-authorize diversion uplift (~$9.2k) on the procurement hold and model the reflash ops cost into the monthly runbook.
Jess K: Procurement notes: If vendor confirms >=5% credit, greenlight diversion. If not, escalate to finance for approval.
OpsBot: RMA-4823 assigned -> Jess K, Sean Patel. Reminder: update the playbook doc `infra/playbooks/rma-divert.md`.
Alex Rivera: I'll update the release calendar and flag any canary services that depend on EU H200 pool. Posting final instruction to vendor by 11:30 UTC unless new info. :thumbsup:
Marco (AltForward): CSV and paperwork will be in your inbox by EOD. AWB-ALF-9987, MFST-4792.
Jess K: Thanks. Quick Q — any DOA reported from the preflight batch?
Marco (AltForward): Preflight inspection flagged 2 DOAs (S1023, S1178). We'll replace under RMA before split if you want them out of the shipped lot.
Sean Patel: Remove DOA from shipping CSV. We'll want replacements to be included in the vendor-held 40% for EU if possible.
Maya Chen: Also note: if we divert to US, escalate cooling-loop check on those hosts — shipping stress has tripped one cooling sensor in past waves. Schedule a thermal soak check post-unpack.
Alex Rivera: Good catch. Add thermal soak + firmware verification to the unpack checklist. Ops, please confirm staging playbook updates by EOD.
OpsBot: Acknowledged. Playbook update task created -> TASK-8871.
Alex Rivera: Thanks everyone. Final call: proceed with 60% -> US diversion unless procurement tells us vendor credit is <5%. Deadline 12:00 UTC tomorrow.
